profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Real-time trading systems across options, equities, futures | Full-stack
profile.summary:
I build the systems traders look at all day. My work runs from the wire to the screen: binary market data feeds, real-time services, and the interfaces desks use to manage risk, PnL, and trading.
 
I work directly with traders and quants to decide what gets built, then set the architectural direction and platform roadmap to deliver it. I lead the technical roadmap with an institutional client and own how our software gets released and deployed.
 
Previously Engineering Manager at Trading Technologies and Staff Engineer at project44.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Trading Systems
positions.description:
- Own the real-time trading platform used daily by internal desks and an institutional client: command and control, risk, PnL, and trade surveillance.
- Built the firm’s first Aeron multicast to browser pipeline: integrated C++ feed handlers with Node through native bindings, streaming live options market data.
- Building an options chain with the options desk, combining multiple data feeds into one view.
Lead the technical roadmap with an institutional client running the platform in its own infrastructure (Docker, RBAC, tenant isolation).
- Architected a trade surveillance application that replaced a manual spreadsheet workflow with automated alerting and reporting.
- Re-architected the heartbeat service, ending recurring trading downtime incidents.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Design · Full-Stack Development · Trading Systems · Data Streaming · Node.js · Microservices · Options · Futures · US Equities · Technical Leadership

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Research Products team. Led the Node 18 upgrade of a client-facing product and six supporting microservices (securities, articles, authentication, usage tracking, calendar) ahead of an AWS end-of-life deadline. Wrote and ran DynamoDB migrations affecting all users.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microservices · Technical Design · Full-Stack Development · Object Oriented Design · Node.js · Vue.js · Databases

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Network Experience team - owned and built a greenfield application (TypeScript, NestJS, React, Microservices) that streamlined carrier onboarding and surfaced network insights for customers. Led four engineers across the US and EU through delivery: design docs, project planning with product and design, code review, and mentoring. Provided direction on technical and product roadmap.
positions.insights: Skills: ReactJS · NestJS · TypeScript · Microservices · Design Documents · Jest · Representational State Transfer (REST) · React Hooks · Technical Design · Full-Stack Development · Object Oriented Design · Node.js · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Computer Science · Algorithms · HTML5 · JavaScript · User Interface Design · Data Structures · Databases · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager | Trading Systems
positions.description: Led the web platform team for a futures, options, and crypto trading platform used by banks, hedge funds, and brokers. Shipped weekly, coordinated releases across teams, and handled production incidents involving high-volume price, order, and fill data. Delivered institutional algo support by integrating third-party trading strategies into order entry via the FIXatdl standard.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built an order management system with the backend team, adding staged orders and order passing between admins and users, plus an audit feature on AWS (API Gateway, Lambda, Redshift). Integrated the CoinFLEX crypto exchange into the platform, normalizing exchange data and adding leverage and repayment features end to end.
